Changes to version "3.11a" (11/12/03):
- Built vocablib.lib to add grammars.  Renamed XBOX_GRAMMAR to FNX_GRAMMAR to allow the header to reflect the functionality of the build as well as placing FNX_GRAMMAR as a preprocessor define in VocabLib.


Changes to version "3.3c" (3/23/03):
- Built Vocablib.lib to fix the heap bug.

Changes to version "3.3b" (3/23/03):
- Built VoiceCmds.lib with /Zl switch set and also XBuildVoice.exe. Also fixed the heap bug.

Changes to version "3.3" (3/12/03):
- Built VocabLib.lib and VoiceCmds.lib with /Nodefaultlib switch set.

Changes to version "3.2" (2/13/03):

- Added 4 new languages German, French, UKEnglish and Spanish.
- Changes to documentation: Reference new languages; added tips on how to make good word list text files (including advice on international characters in new languages).
- Modified dictionary code to support new languages.  Now better handles international characters, and more quietly ignores punctuation.

Changes to version "3.1" (2/4/03):

- Fixed bug in VoiceCmdsLib.lib that was preventing multiple simultaneous vocabularies from being used.
- Checked for NULL pointer passed into FnxSelectVocabs().
- Enhanced dictionary support in preparation for other languages.
